meta.name: Socialist Party of Timor
meta.description: Official portal of the Socialist Party of Timor (PST): news, programme, documents, events and online membership registration. Pelo Progresso, Igualdade.

footer.about: Official portal of the Socialist Party of Timor. Learn about our programme, follow our activities and take part in the political life of the country.
footer.privacy: Personal data sent through this portal is used only to handle your registration or request, and is stored securely.
footer.rights: © {year} Socialist Party of Timor. All rights reserved.

home.heroLead: Together for a fair, equal and free Timor-Leste. Learn about our programme, join our activities and make your voice heard.
home.latestNewsLead: The latest from the party and the municipalities.
home.noNews: No news has been published yet.
home.upcomingEventsLead: Congresses, rallies and community discussions across the country.
home.noEvents: No events are scheduled at the moment.
home.featuredDocumentsLead: The party's statute, political programme and resolutions.
home.noDocuments: No documents have been published yet.
home.municipalitiesLead: Find the secretariat and municipal committee nearest to you.
home.joinLead: Quick and secure online registration. Get your reference number straight away and follow the status of your membership card (E-KTA).
home.voiceLead: Share problems, aspirations or proposals from your community. You can submit anonymously and follow the reply with a code.

join.title: Join the PST
join.lead: Fill in this form to become a member of the Socialist Party of Timor. The secretariat checks your details before issuing your E-KTA card.
join.minAge: Registration is open to citizens aged {age} or over.
join.fullNameHint: As shown on your identity document.
join.idNumberHint: We store this number encrypted; only the last 4 digits are ever shown.
join.photoHint: JPG/PNG/WEBP image, max {max} MB. Face clearly visible, light background.
join.fileTooLarge: The file is too large. Maximum {max} MB.
join.motivation: Why do you want to join the PST?
join.consent: I declare that the information is true and I authorise the PST to process my personal data to manage party membership.
join.successTitle: Thank you! We have received your registration.
join.successBody: Keep your reference number. You'll need it, with your date of birth, to check your registration status.
join.duplicate: This identity document is already registered. Check your registration status or contact your municipal secretariat.

status.title: Registration status
status.lead: Enter your reference number and date of birth to check your registration.
status.notFound: No registration matches this reference and date of birth.
status.PENDING: Your registration is awaiting verification by the secretariat.
status.VERIFIED: Congratulations! You are a verified PST member.
status.REJECTED: The registration was not approved. Contact your municipal secretariat for details.
status.SUSPENDED: This membership is suspended. Contact your municipal secretariat.

voice.title: Voice of the People
voice.lead: Send the PST problems, complaints or proposals from your community. A team reads and replies.
voice.anonymousHint: We won't store your name or contact details.
voice.name: Name
voice.subject: Subject
voice.messageHint: Describe the problem, where it is and who is affected.
voice.attachmentsHint: Up to {count} files, max {max} MB each.
voice.warning: Save this code now. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered, and you need it to see the reply.
voice.trackLead: Enter your ticket number and tracking code.
voice.notFound: No ticket matches this number and code.
voice.noReplies: No reply yet. Please check again in a few days.
voice.nameRequired: Name is required unless you submit anonymously.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Write to us. We'll reply as soon as we can.
contact.name: Name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.emailOrPhone: Give an e-mail or phone number so we can reply.
contact.successBody: Thank you. We'll be in touch soon.
contact.noHq: Headquarters contact details will be published here. Meanwhile, use the form or contact the office in your municipality.
contact.voiceHint: A problem in your community? Use Voice of the People to track the reply.

verify.title: Membership card verification
verify.validBody: This card is authentic and the member is active in the PST.
verify.EXPIRED_body: The card is authentic but its validity has ended.
verify.MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE_body: This member is suspended or not active in the PST.
verify.SIGNATURE_INVALID_body: This card failed digital signature verification. It may be forged.
verify.NOT_FOUND_body: This QR code does not match any active PST card.
verify.name: Name
verify.note: Compare the photo with the person presenting the card.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
